name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project located in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The company received key environmental approvals from Salta authorities in 2026 and was approved under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI). AbraSilver is in the advanced development stage with Kinross as a strategic investor.
